statement: The correspondence record lists t.okonkwo@riverbend.edu as the “Recipient for the decision letter,” but it also shows Dr M. Salvatierra at m.salvatierra@utsalta.ar as the corresponding author and notes the letter names the authors.
judge_text:
WRONG
It flags the specific conflict — the recipient field names the reviewer while the letter "names the authors" and the corresponding author is Dr Salvatierra — identifying the double-blind breach in the record.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
